title: Source Current
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the total current from the power source using Ohm's law for the complete circuit, accounting for all resistors and internal resistance.

title: Plate Voltage
description: Important: Correctly determines the voltage across the capacitor plates by applying Ohm's law to the relevant resistor in the circuit.

title: Electric Field Strength
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the uniform electric field strength between the plates using the relationship between voltage and plate separation.

title: Force Balance Setup
description: Important: States the correct equilibrium condition where the droplet's weight equals the electric force, mg = qE.

title: Charge Sign
description: Essential: Correctly identifies that the droplet must carry a negative charge to be suspended against gravity with the given field direction.

title: Charge Magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly solves the force balance equation for the magnitude of the droplet's charge.

title: Equivalent Resistance Error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly combines the resistors in the circuit (e.g., treating them as parallel or omitting the internal resistance).

title: Field Direction Mistake
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns the sign of the charge (e.g., stating positive) based on a misunderstanding of the force balance or field direction.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional: Demonstrates dimensional analysis or unit consistency in the final expressions for current, field, and charge.
